content: For this reason, numerous of systems and approaches have been developed during the last decades to attempt to automate the anonymisation of sensitive content, starting with the automatic detection and classification of sensitive information. Some of these systems rely on rules, patterns and dictionaries, while others use more advanced techniques related to machine learning and, more recently, deep learning.
